responsibility: This file implements a late RTL instruction-combination pass built on `rtl-ssa` that tries to delete single-set definitions by substituting their sources into all uses. It analyzes whether a defining insn can be safely copied or its value propagated into nondebug and debug users, checks resource-definition consistency, recognition validity, motion constraints, register-pressure limits before reload, and note/debug preservation, then commits coordinated RTL/SSA updates and CFG cleanup. Its role is a conservative, late-stage combine pass focused on whole-definition elimination rather than the earlier general-purpose `combine` pass.
